title: Pennies Lose $86 Million A Year To Produce
hook: Pennies lose taxpayers $86 million every year.
closing: Small coins can create surprisingly large losses for taxpayers.
question: Would you miss the penny?

segments.say: Making pennies loses $86 million each year. A one-cent coin creates a massive recurring bill.
The penny has remained in production for 232 years. Few obsolete coins lasted nearly as long.
A nickel costs 13.78 cents to produce. The penny is not even the worst money-losing coin.
